[[sn:Crowned Noble]][[sn:Crowned Noble]]Crowned Nobles are [[Nobles]] who have formally undergone the process of following the [[Lambda Covenant]] and as such can have their nobility reliably known by others. This gives them a lot of advantages in terms of trustworthiness. As with all nobles crowned nobles may [[trip]] but their tripping will be reliably detected and corrected
